items.title: Admin control for org-wide agent sharing
items.summary: Admins can govern who may create org-wide sharing links for agents built in Copilot Studio agent builder.
items.whatToReview: Confirm your agent publishing and sharing authorization limits who can share agents organization-wide.

controls.title: Restrict Agent Publishing by Authorization
controls.rationale: Governs who can publish and share agents organization-wide.

controls.title: Policy-Based Agent Publishing Restrictions
controls.rationale: Policy-based publishing restrictions apply to sharing scope.

items.title: Agent ownership reassignment
items.summary: Admins can reassign ownership of shared agents created in Copilot Studio or the Microsoft 365 Agents Toolkit.
items.whatToReview: Add ownership reassignment to your orphaned-agent detection and remediation runbook.

controls.title: Agent Registry and Integrated Apps Management
controls.rationale: Ownership is part of agent registry and integrated-apps management.

controls.title: Orphaned Agent Detection and Remediation
controls.rationale: Reassignment is a remediation path for orphaned agents.

items.title: Audit logs for agent management
items.summary: Agent admin actions such as publishing and blocking are recorded in Purview unified audit logs.
items.whatToReview: Confirm agent admin actions are captured and retained per your recordkeeping obligations.

controls.title: Comprehensive Audit Logging and Compliance
controls.rationale: Agent admin actions become part of comprehensive audit logging.

controls.title: Compliance and Regulatory Reporting
controls.rationale: Captured actions support compliance and regulatory reporting (for example, SEC 17a-4, FINRA 4511).

items.title: Purview DSPM for AI - apps and agents
items.summary: A dashboard of apps and agents used across the organization to surface potential data-security risks.
items.whatToReview: Enable the apps-and-agents view and triage flagged agents.

controls.title: Microsoft Purview DSPM for AI
controls.rationale: Direct extension of Purview DSPM for AI coverage to agents.

controls.title: Defender AI Security Posture Management (AI-SPM)
controls.rationale: Feeds AI security posture management signals.

items.title: Agent metadata in inventory export
items.summary: Inventory export adds metadata fields covering capabilities, data sources, actions, created-in, and created-by.
items.whatToReview: Fold the expanded export fields into your inventory and evidence collection.

controls.title: Agent Inventory and Metadata Management
controls.rationale: Expanded fields enrich agent inventory and metadata management.

controls.title: Agent Registry and Integrated Apps Management
controls.rationale: Supports the agent registry record for each agent.

items.title: Graph APIs for app and agent inventory
items.summary: New Microsoft Graph endpoints provide programmatic access to app and agent inventory and details.
items.whatToReview: Evaluate adopting the Graph endpoints to automate agent inventory evidence.

controls.title: Agent Registry and Integrated Apps Management
controls.rationale: Programmatic registry access for agent management.

controls.title: Agent Inventory and Metadata Management
controls.rationale: Enables automated inventory and metadata collection.

controls.title: Centralized Agent Inventory Enforcement
controls.rationale: Supports centralized agent inventory enforcement.

items.title: SharePoint agents in the Agents page
items.summary: SharePoint agents appear as shared agents in the Microsoft 365 admin center, with block and unblock from inventory.
items.whatToReview: Bring SharePoint agents into your unified inventory and block/unblock governance.

controls.title: SharePoint Security and Compliance Monitoring
controls.rationale: SharePoint agents fall under SharePoint security and compliance monitoring.

controls.title: Restrict Agent Publishing by Authorization
controls.rationale: Block and unblock governs agent availability.

controls.title: Centralized Agent Inventory Enforcement
controls.rationale: Brings SharePoint agents into centralized inventory enforcement.

items.title: Security and compliance info for more agents
items.summary: The Teams admin center shows security and compliance information for more certified or publisher-attested apps and agents.
items.whatToReview: Use the certification and attestation signals in agent vetting and third-party risk review.

controls.title: Vendor and Third-Party Risk Management
controls.rationale: Certification and attestation signals inform third-party risk review.

controls.title: Agent Registry and Integrated Apps Management
controls.rationale: Feeds vetting data into the agent registry.

items.title: Larger file uploads in agent builder
items.summary: Copilot Studio agent builder supports larger file uploads, up to 512 MB.
items.whatToReview: Larger uploads widen the ingestion surface; verify your file-upload and file-type restrictions.

controls.title: Agent File Upload and File Analysis Restrictions
controls.rationale: Larger uploads widen the agent file-upload and analysis surface.

controls.title: MIME Type Restrictions for File Uploads
controls.rationale: MIME-type restrictions govern which uploads are accepted.

items.title: Approval flow for Frontier and Microsoft agents
items.summary: Frontier-program and Microsoft-built agents can be reviewed through an admin request-approval flow in the Microsoft 365 admin center.
items.whatToReview: Decide who owns agent approval decisions and how requests are triaged.

controls.title: Restrict Agent Publishing by Authorization
controls.rationale: Approval gating governs which agents are published to users.

controls.title: Agent Feature Enablement and Restriction Governance
controls.rationale: Part of agent feature enablement and restriction governance.

controls.title: Microsoft Agent 365 — Admin Center Governance Console
controls.rationale: Surfaced through the Agent 365 admin-center governance console.

items.title: MCP-compliant tools in agent workflows
items.summary: Copilot Studio agents can use MCP-compliant tools to reach external systems and custom actions.
items.whatToReview: Extend connector and DLP policies and third-party risk review to cover MCP tools.

controls.title: Advanced Connector Policies (ACP)
controls.rationale: Connector policies govern which external tools agents may reach.

controls.title: Data Minimization and Agent Scope Control
controls.rationale: External tool access affects data minimization and agent scope.

controls.title: Vendor and Third-Party Risk Management
controls.rationale: Third-party tools require vendor and third-party risk review.

items.title: Invoke agents as workflow steps (agent node)
items.summary: An agent node lets one workflow invoke another agent as a single reasoning step.
items.whatToReview: Set limits and oversight for agent-to-agent orchestration depth.

controls.title: Multi-Agent Orchestration Limits
controls.rationale: Agent-to-agent invocation is governed by multi-agent orchestration limits.

items.title: Workforce Insights agent for organizational data
items.summary: A Copilot agent gives authorized leaders, managers, and delegates views of organizational structure, staffing, skills, and work-pattern data.
items.whatToReview: Define eligible roles, delegated access, and the minimum workforce data exposed through the agent.

controls.title: Data Minimization and Agent Scope Control
controls.rationale: Workforce queries should be limited to the organizational data needed for the user's role.

controls.title: Application-Level Authorization and Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)
controls.rationale: Role-based access should restrict workforce insights to authorized leaders, managers, and delegates.

items.title: Insider risk indicators and scoring for agents
items.summary: Purview Insider Risk Management adds agent-specific activity indicators and risk scoring to investigations of potentially harmful agent behavior.
items.whatToReview: Add agent indicators to insider-risk policies, alert triage, and investigation procedures.

controls.title: Insider Risk Detection and Response
controls.rationale: Agent-specific indicators and scores extend insider-risk detection and triage to agent activity.

items.title: Data Security Triage Agent investigation enhancements
items.summary: Purview's triage agent adds clearer risk-pattern and activity summaries to Insider Risk Management investigations.
items.whatToReview: Validate how the revised summaries affect triage decisions, escalation criteria, and analyst review.

controls.title: Insider Risk Detection and Response
controls.rationale: Revised summaries support insider-risk triage and investigation of detected activity patterns.

items.title: SharePoint lists as Agent Builder knowledge
items.summary: Agent Builder can ground an agent in one SharePoint list of up to 20,000 items, alongside other supported knowledge sources.
items.whatToReview: Approve eligible lists, validate list quality and permissions, and account for unsupported attachments and lookup columns.

controls.title: Data Minimization and Agent Scope Control
controls.rationale: List selection and exposed fields should be limited to the data the agent needs.

controls.title: RAG Source Integrity Validation
controls.rationale: Structured list data should be validated for quality, currency, and permissions before grounding.

controls.title: Grounding Scope Governance
controls.rationale: The selected SharePoint list defines an additional grounding boundary for the agent.

items.title: Teams built-in agent management
items.summary: Teams admin center provides centralized availability controls for built-in agents used in chats, channels, and meetings.
items.whatToReview: Inventory built-in Teams agents and set availability by user and group before relying on licensed-user defaults.

controls.title: Agent Registry and Integrated Apps Management
controls.rationale: Built-in Teams agents should be included in the centrally managed agent inventory.

controls.title: Agent Feature Enablement and Restriction Governance
controls.rationale: User and group availability settings govern where built-in agents are enabled.

items.title: Insider risk triage summaries in Defender
items.summary: Defender alert queues can show Purview Insider Risk Management triage-agent summaries, with deeper investigation remaining in Purview.
items.whatToReview: Confirm analysts understand the summary's limits and retain a handoff to the full Purview investigation.

controls.title: Insider Risk Detection and Response
controls.rationale: Cross-portal summaries affect insider-risk alert triage and investigation workflows.

items.title: Agent 365 dashboard for leaders
items.summary: Copilot Analytics adds an Agent 365 dashboard with historical activity for registered agents.
items.whatToReview: Define who can view agent activity, which usage trends are monitored, and how findings are escalated.

controls.title: Usage Analytics and Activity Monitoring
controls.rationale: Historical Agent 365 activity expands usage analytics and monitoring for registered agents.

items.title: Agent2Agent connections for Agent 365 agents
items.summary: Agents registered in Agent 365 can act as connected agents in Agent Builder or Copilot Studio when they implement the Agent2Agent protocol.
items.whatToReview: Set approval, trust, and orchestration limits before allowing registered agents to be connected.

controls.title: Multi-Agent Orchestration Limits
controls.rationale: Connected-agent use requires limits on trust, invocation paths, and orchestration scope.

items.title: Unified app and agent installation management
items.summary: Installation changes made in Microsoft 365 or Teams admin center apply consistently across Teams, Outlook, and Microsoft 365 Copilot.
items.whatToReview: Reconcile existing installation policies and verify the unified setting produces the intended inventory and access state.

controls.title: Agent Registry and Integrated Apps Management
controls.rationale: Unified installation settings consolidate agent and app management across supported surfaces.

items.title: Agent 365 dashboard for managers
items.summary: Copilot Analytics gives managers historical activity views for agents registered through Agent 365.
items.whatToReview: Set manager access boundaries and define which usage patterns require follow-up.

controls.title: Usage Analytics and Activity Monitoring
controls.rationale: Manager-facing history provides another view of registered-agent activity and usage trends.

items.title: Run-only sharing for autonomous agents
items.summary: Copilot Studio makers can share autonomous agents with users for execution without granting edit rights or ownership.
items.whatToReview: Define who may share autonomous agents and verify run-only users cannot edit or assume ownership.

controls.title: Restrict Agent Publishing by Authorization
controls.rationale: Authorization should govern who may publish or share autonomous agents for use.

controls.title: Application-Level Authorization and Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)
controls.rationale: Run-only access separates execution rights from editing and ownership privileges.

items.title: Agent readiness checks before publishing
items.summary: Copilot Studio surfaces policy restrictions, missing evaluations, and other readiness risks in the agent build experience before publication.
items.whatToReview: Incorporate readiness findings into publish gates and require unresolved policy or evaluation issues to be reviewed.

controls.title: Policy-Based Agent Publishing Restrictions
controls.rationale: Readiness findings expose policy restrictions that affect whether an agent can be published.

controls.title: Testing, Validation, and Quality Assurance
controls.rationale: Missing evaluations and other readiness risks should feed pre-publication quality gates.

items.title: SQL data-source support in Copilot Studio
items.summary: Copilot Studio is adding support for using data from a SQL server as an agent knowledge source.
items.whatToReview: Limit exposed schemas and records, validate source quality and permissions, and test grounded responses.

controls.title: Data Minimization and Agent Scope Control
controls.rationale: SQL schemas and records exposed to an agent should be limited to its approved purpose.

controls.title: RAG Source Integrity Validation
controls.rationale: Data used for SQL-backed grounding should be validated for quality, currency, and permissions.

items.title: Agents usage report in the Microsoft 365 admin center
items.summary: A Microsoft 365 admin center report shows agent usage across Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Chat, including active agents, active licensed and unlicensed users, and a breakdown by agent publisher type.
items.whatToReview: Decide who may view agent usage data and fold active-agent and publisher-type metrics into your agent inventory and monitoring reviews.

controls.title: Usage Analytics and Activity Monitoring
controls.rationale: Active-agent and active-user metrics extend usage analytics and activity monitoring to agents.

controls.title: Agent Inventory and Metadata Management
controls.rationale: Publisher-type and per-agent usage detail supports the agent inventory and metadata record.

items.title: Data Security Posture Agent in Purview DSPM
items.summary: A Purview DSPM agent uses large language models to discover sensitive data across documents, emails, and messages from a natural-language intent and to assess the associated risks.
items.whatToReview: Scope who may run the agent and over which data, and fold its risk findings into your DSPM triage and oversight process.

controls.title: Microsoft Purview DSPM for AI
controls.rationale: The agent extends Purview DSPM for AI with model-based discovery of sensitive data across the estate.

controls.title: Data Minimization and Agent Scope Control
controls.rationale: Discovery runs read documents, emails, and messages broadly, so their scope and authorization should be reviewed.

items.title: Dataverse as a Copilot Studio knowledge source
items.summary: Copilot Studio adds Microsoft Dataverse as a native knowledge source, letting agents ground responses in structured business records and application data.
items.whatToReview: Limit which Dataverse tables and records ground the agent, and validate source quality and permissions before relying on grounded answers.

controls.title: Data Minimization and Agent Scope Control
controls.rationale: Dataverse tables and records exposed to an agent should be limited to its approved purpose.

controls.title: RAG Source Integrity Validation
controls.rationale: Dataverse data used for grounding should be validated for quality, currency, and permissions.

items.title: Declarative agents can ground on scanned PDFs
items.summary: Newly created declarative agents can ground answers in scanned and image-based PDF documents referenced from SharePoint.
items.whatToReview: Re-check SharePoint access governance, restricted content discovery, and monitoring coverage for scanned and image-based documents used by agents.

controls.title: SharePoint Information Access Governance (IAG) / Restricted Content Discovery
controls.rationale: Image-based SharePoint content becomes available for agent grounding, so site access governance and restricted-content controls must cover it.

controls.title: SharePoint Security and Compliance Monitoring
controls.rationale: Security and compliance monitoring should include scanned documents that agents can now retrieve from SharePoint.

items.title: Conversational connector configuration in Copilot Studio
items.summary: Makers can add and authenticate connectors for an agent through an in-chat flow instead of using the full settings experience.
items.whatToReview: Verify connector policy, data loss prevention, authentication, and consent scope remain enforced when connectors are configured through the conversational flow.

controls.title: Advanced Connector Policies (ACP)
controls.rationale: The lower-friction connector setup path must remain governed by Advanced Connector Policies and data loss prevention controls.

items.title: Maker-to-maker agent sharing
items.summary: Makers can grant other makers Viewer or Editor access to an agent, with the corresponding security roles assigned automatically.
items.whatToReview: Review who may grant Viewer or Editor access, validate automatic role assignment against least privilege, and confirm publishing restrictions still apply to shared agents.

controls.title: Restrict Agent Publishing by Authorization
controls.rationale: Maker sharing can grant edit and publish capabilities, so authorization must restrict who may assign those privileges.

controls.title: Policy-Based Agent Publishing Restrictions
controls.rationale: Policy-based publishing restrictions should continue to constrain agents shared with makers who receive Editor access.
